name: craft
description: Software craftsmanship discipline skills: grill-with-docs (vocabulary grilling against per-repo CONTEXT.md glossaries), diagnose, prototype, tdd, improve-codebase-architecture, grok (stateful multi-session codebase comprehension with supersession-aware understanding records), zoom-out (adapted in part from mattpocock/skills, MIT), infra-review (architecture/security review of Terraform+Atlantis PRs), quiz-me (opt-in active-recall comprehension check after a code explanation), and interrogate-model (holistic representability review of a domain model — the legitimate scenarios and personas it cannot express). Composes with spec-flow and ndr plugins.
